title: DC House of Horror #1 DC Comics 2017 Michael Kaluta Cover Keith Giffen One-Shot
conditionDescription: Square-bound 80-page giant. Covers clean with no creases or tears; light wear along the spine. See photos.
descriptionText:
DC House of Horror #1 (December 2017), DC Comics. 80-page square-bound horror anthology one-shot reimagining Superman, Wonder Woman, Batman, the Flash and Green Lantern as horror stories. Written by Keith Giffen, Michael Kaluta cover. $9.99 cover price.

Back cover: Middle-earth: Shadow of War video game ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
